mapper.sql: uc.user_coupon_id, uc.user_id, uc.coupon_id, uc.status, uc.reservation_id, uc.issued_at, uc.expires_at, uc.used_at, c.coupon_name, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, c.max_discount, c.min_order_amount, c.salon_id AS coupon_salon_id, c.service_id AS coupon_service_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM User_Coupons uc JOIN Coupons c ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'available' AND uc.expires_at > NOW() AND c.is_active = 1 ORDER BY uc.expires_at
mapper.update: UPDATE User_Coupons SET status = 'used', used_at = NOW() WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'reserved'
UPDATE User_Coupons SET status = CASE WHEN expires_at > NOW() THEN 'available' ELSE 'expired' END, reservation_id = NULL WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'reserved'
UPDATE User_Coupons SET status = CASE WHEN expires_at > NOW() THEN 'available' ELSE 'expired' END, reservation_id = NULL, used_at = NULL WHERE reservation_id = #{reservationId} AND status = 'used'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM User_Coupons uc JOIN Coupons c ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.status = 'available' AND uc.expires_at > NOW() AND c.is_active = 1

SELECT FROM User_Coupons uc JOIN Coupons c ON c.coupon_id = uc.coupon_id WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY CASE WHEN uc.status = 'available' AND uc.expires_at > NOW() THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, uc.expires_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO User_Coupons (user_id, coupon_id, status, expires_at) SELECT #{userId}, c.coupon_id, 'available', TIMESTAMP(c.valid_until, '23:59:59') FROM Coupons c WHERE c.coupon_id = #{couponId} AND c.is_active = 1 AND CURDATE() BETWEEN c.valid_from AND c.valid_until AND (c.once_per_user = 0 OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT user_id, coupon_id FROM User_Coupons) uc WHERE uc.user_id = #{userId} AND uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id))
mapper.select: SELECT coupon_id, promotion_id, salon_id, service_id, coupon_name, coupon_code, discount_type, discount_value, max_discount, min_order_amount, valid_from, valid_until, issue_type, once_per_user, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM Coupons WHERE issue_type = #{issueType} AND is_active = 1 AND CURDATE() BETWEEN valid_from AND valid_until

SELECT coupon_id, promotion_id, salon_id, service_id, coupon_name, coupon_code, discount_type, discount_value, max_discount, min_order_amount, valid_from, valid_until, issue_type, once_per_user, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM Coupons WHERE coupon_code = #{couponCode}

SELECT c.coupon_id, c.promotion_id, c.salon_id, c.service_id, c.coupon_name, c.coupon_code, c.discount_type, c.discount_value, c.max_discount, c.min_order_amount, c.valid_from, c.valid_until, c.issue_type, c.once_per_user, c.is_active, c.created_at, c.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM User_Coupons uc WHERE uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id) AS issued_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM User_Coupons uc WHERE uc.coupon_id = c.coupon_id AND uc.status = 'used') AS used_count FROM Coupons c ORDER BY c.coupon_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM User_Coupons WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND coupon_id = #{couponId}

SELECT coupon_id, promotion_id, salon_id, service_id, coupon_name, coupon_code, discount_type, discount_value, max_discount, min_order_amount, valid_from, valid_until, issue_type, once_per_user, is_active, created_at, updated_at FROM Coupons WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO Coupons (promotion_id, salon_id, service_id, coupon_name, coupon_code, discount_type, discount_value, max_discount, min_order_amount, valid_from, valid_until, issue_type, once_per_user, is_active) VALUES (#{promotionId}, #{salonId}, #{serviceId}, #{couponName}, #{couponCode}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{maxDiscount}, #{minOrderAmount}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil}, #{issueType}, #{oncePerUser}, #{isActive})
